name: escape-option-by-description
description: The same three options plus small_talk, whose key does not look like an escape but whose description mentions a greeting: that counts as an escape option, so no lint fires.

question.instructions: Which products does `assistant_response` recommend to the user?

mentions_competitor.what: Recommends or praises a competing product
mentions_competitor.not_for: Neutral comparisons the user asked for

mentions_own_product.what: Recommends one of our own plans or add-ons
mentions_own_product.not_for: Replies that only mention a competitor

mentions_both.what: Compares one of our plans with a competing product

small_talk.what: A greeting, thanks, or small talk with no product in it
